workflow: research new/reactivated/materially changed problems in the same run
queue current validated remedies as durable work items
advance bounded work items through audit, baseline, candidate, evaluation, promotion, release, and propagation

results.notes: Second pilot (0.4.0 controller, branch controller-0.4.0). Phase A: no due inventory/sources. Phase B: action_queue selected 3 implementation + 3 decision items mechanically; controller planned 8 representative items via plan_action (D03, D02, D16, G22, F03, J10, I03, D09). Branches exercised: instruction→agent-instruction-maintenance (D03 candidate: 2 iterations, 18 blind executor runs, 4 gradings, REJECTED — improvement not confirmed; D09 trigger-evals candidate: deterministic, promoted, release branch-pushed, PR pending), model-specific→model-behavior-operations (D02, after model_conditions scope fix; covered → completed), Skill eval→skill-optimization (D16 covered → completed), consumer-configuration/knowledge-only/solution-adoption → guidance propagation events for techlog (G22, J10, I06, I08, I16, F03), R3 decision packages (G17, I14, I01, I03). No new Skill/Plugin created. Controller fixes discovered: model_conditions text scope, guidance propagation without release, promotion gate for deterministic changes, adjacent-cell trial inflation, no candidate-revision path before evaluation, version collision across pending releases (0.1.1 vs 0.1.2).
